  PR title MUST be a Conventional Commit, e.g. `feat(auth): add social login`.
  It becomes the squash-merge commit and is validated by CI.
-->

## What & why

<!-- Briefly describe the change and the motivation. Link issues: Closes #123 -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] refactor / perf
- [ ] docs
- [ ] chore / build / ci
- [ ] Breaking change (`!` in title or `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer)

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] `melos run analyze` passes
- [ ] `melos run format` passes
- [ ] `melos run test` passes (added/updated tests where it matters)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior/architecture changed
